summary: Iteration 12 (Customer Display) fully verified. Backend WS relay (cart.update/cart.clear) works with proper sender-exclusion and tenant isolation. Regression suites all green. Frontend flows: sidebar link, /display idle (bypasses CashierGate), live cart preview updates via WS in a second tab, and thank-you screen with tip + auto-return to idle after ~10s all pass. QR block correctly conditional on business.qr_url.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — WS receive_text loop only parses JSON when message is not 'ping'; this is fine but note that a raw 'ping' text is intentional and not JSON; the try/except catches malformed messages silently which is OK.
server.py cart relay iterates realtime._conns directly (private-ish access). Consider adding a public relay method on RealtimeManager for encapsulation (nice-to-have, not blocking).

CustomerDisplayPage: while thankTimerRef is active, cart.update messages are ignored (good) — but if the cashier starts a new order within 10s the display will not preview it until the thank-you window ends. Consider clearing the thank timer on the next non-empty cart.update to feel snappier.

useRealtime.js: sendRealtime uses the module-level sharedWs which is fine, but there's no queue if the socket is not yet OPEN — early cart.update emissions right after login could silently drop. Consider a small tiny queue or retry on 'open'.
